research.notes: The ct3education.com site never spells out 'Center for Transformative Teacher Training'; the link rests on the SF business registry DBA at the identical address plus a third-party profile (theorg.com). The registry lists the owner as Eduservice Inc, which may be the legal entity, but it was not confirmed on a primary source so legalName is left null.
